record.title: Masters Degree In Continuing Education In Business Administration (MBA) in London 2027
record.longDescription: The Master’s Degree in Continuing Education in Business Administration is designed to develop advanced managerial, analytical, and leadership skills required in today’s competitive business landscape. The programme focuses on strategic decision-making, global business understanding, and organizational leadership. Learners will gain knowledge in finance, marketing, human resources, and research methodologies while strengthening their ability to manage complex business challenges. The course prepares professionals for senior leadership roles across diverse industries.
record.courseDetails:
The MBA programme empowers aspiring professionals with strategic, analytical, and leadership skills to excel in a competitive global business environment. It blends theoretical knowledge with practical application through case studies, simulations, and real-world projects. Core disciplines include finance, marketing, HR, leadership, research, and global enterprise management. Graduates emerge as well-rounded, decision-oriented leaders ready to drive organizational success and innovation.The programme includes 10 modules of 7 ECTS each and a thesis of 20 ECTS, allowing students to apply their knowledge to practical research. Graduates will be prepared for leadership and strategic roles in organizations worldwide.

Upon completion of this programme, learners will be able to:

Analyze business environments and develop effective strategic management plans.

Apply strategic leadership principles to guide organizational success.

Evaluate human resource strategies that support organizational performance.

Develop marketing strategies that enhance competitiveness and brand positioning.

Interpret financial information to support strategic financial decision-making.

Apply advanced research methods to investigate business problems and develop solutions.

Promote employee engagement and organizational learning in the workplace.

Manage business operations effectively using modern management practices.

Assess global business environments and develop international business strategies.

Demonstrate leadership and organizational behaviour skills to manage teams and organizational change.

The process includes proposal development, literature review, data collection, analysis, and reporting. It culminates in a scholarly, professionally presented dissertation aligned with strategic business objectives

Masters Degree In Continuing Education In Business Administration (MBA)

The Master’s Degree in Continuing Education in Business Administration is designed to develop advanced managerial, analytical, and leadership skills required in today’s competitive business landscape. The programme focuses on strategic decision-making, global business understanding, and organizational leadership. Learners will gain knowledge in finance, marketing, human resources, and research methodologies while strengthening their ability to manage complex business challenges. The course prepares professionals for senior leadership roles across diverse industries.
Course Details

The MBA programme empowers aspiring professionals with strategic, analytical, and leadership skills to excel in a competitive global business environment. It blends theoretical knowledge with practical application through case studies, simulations, and real-world projects. Core disciplines include finance, marketing, HR, leadership, research, and global enterprise management. Graduates emerge as well-rounded, decision-oriented leaders ready to drive organizational success and innovation.The programme includes 10 modules of 7 ECTS each and a thesis of 20 ECTS, allowing students to apply their knowledge to practical research. Graduates will be prepared for leadership and strategic roles in organizations worldwide.
Upon completion of this programme, learners will be able to:
Analyze business environments and develop effective strategic management plans.
Apply strategic leadership principles to guide organizational success.
Evaluate human resource strategies that support organizational performance.
Develop marketing strategies that enhance competitiveness and brand positioning.
Interpret financial information to support strategic financial decision-making.
Apply advanced research methods to investigate business problems and develop solutions.
Promote employee engagement and organizational learning in the workplace.
Manage business operations effectively using modern management practices.
Assess global business environments and develop international business strategies.
Demonstrate leadership and organizational behaviour skills to manage teams and organizational change.

evidence.heading: courseDetails
evidence.text:
Course Details
The MBA programme empowers aspiring professionals with strategic, analytical, and leadership skills to excel in a competitive global business environment. It blends theoretical knowledge with practical application through case studies, simulations, and real-world projects. Core disciplines include finance, marketing, HR, leadership, research, and global enterprise management. Graduates emerge as well-rounded, decision-oriented leaders ready to drive organizational success and innovation.The programme includes 10 modules of 7 ECTS each and a thesis of 20 ECTS, allowing students to apply their knowledge to practical research. Graduates will be prepared for leadership and strategic roles in organizations worldwide.
Upon completion of this programme, learners will be able to:
Analyze business environments and develop effective strategic management plans.
Apply strategic leadership principles to guide organizational success.
Evaluate human resource strategies that support organizational performance.
Develop marketing strategies that enhance competitiveness and brand positioning.
Interpret financial information to support strategic financial decision-making.
Apply advanced research methods to investigate business problems and develop solutions.
Promote employee engagement and organizational learning in the workplace.
Manage business operations effectively using modern management practices.
Assess global business environments and develop international business strategies.
Demonstrate leadership and organizational behaviour skills to manage teams and organizational change.

The MBA programme empowers aspiring professionals with strategic, analytical, and leadership skills to excel in a competitive global business environment. It blends theoretical knowledge with practical application through case studies, simulations, and real-world projects. Core disciplines include finance, marketing, HR, leadership, research, and global enterprise management. Graduates emerge as well-rounded, decision-oriented leaders ready to drive organizational success and innovation.The programme includes 10 modules of 7 ECTS each and a thesis of 20 ECTS, allowing students to apply their knowledge to practical research. Graduates will be prepared for leadership and strategic roles in organizations worldwide.
Upon completion of this programme, learners will be able to:
Analyze business environments and develop effective strategic management plans.
Apply strategic leadership principles to guide organizational success.
Evaluate human resource strategies that support organizational performance.
Develop marketing strategies that enhance competitiveness and brand positioning.
Interpret financial information to support strategic financial decision-making.
Apply advanced research methods to investigate business problems and develop solutions.
Promote employee engagement and organizational learning in the workplace.
Manage business operations effectively using modern management practices.
Assess global business environments and develop international business strategies.
Demonstrate leadership and organizational behaviour skills to manage teams and organizational change."},{"contentHash":"bb34ddcc85b1ebb23185de6ca561c6fe6ab1e3aab02cc24e13b25702a0cb9da3","courseSlug":"masters-degree-in-continuing-education-in-business-administration","heading":"learningOutcomes","id":"chunk-dc3e2c4b097ab02f11fb11c4","items":[{"text":"Analyze business environments and develop effective strategic management plans.","type":"li"},{"text":"Apply strategic leadership principles to guide organizational success.","type":"li"},{"text":"Evaluate human resource strategies that support organizational performance.","type":"li"},{"text":"Develop marketing strategies that enhance competitiveness and brand positioning.","type":"li"},{"text":"Interpret financial information to support strategic financial decision-making.","type":"li"},{"text":"Apply advanced research methods to investigate business problems and develop solutions.","type":"li"},{"text":"Promote employee engagement and organizational learning in the workplace.","type":"li"},{"text":"Manage business operations effectively using modern management practices.","type":"li"},{"text":"Assess global business environments and develop international business strategies.","type":"li"},{"text":"Demonstrate leadership and organizational behaviour skills to manage teams and organizational change.","type":"li"}],"kind":"programme","ordinal":0,"scope":"global","sectionId":"learningOutcomes","selector":"[id="course-details"] > ol:nth-child(4)","snapshotId":"snapshot-8dd277122e146cc3d86a30cb5312db509056d61838206fa31cf3272c27e47040","text":"Analyze business environments and develop effective strategic management plans.
